resolution.note: product-release smoke accepts doctor exit 65 (stale adopted packs); regression test red on the old script, green on the fix

title: Pack growth no longer blocks the Product release refresh
body:
Why: after c21df4d (#1006) added Go and Python records, product-release kept 331cd57 because the candidate's bin/krn doctor exits 65 (PACK_STALE_EXIT) when registered adopted repos lack the new records. Every pack growth therefore blocks the Product entry refresh until someone runs krn adopt --refresh-all.
Outcome: the release smoke accepts doctor exit 65 (host registry staleness, not a candidate defect) and still refuses any other non-zero exit.
Proof: test/cli/product-release.test.ts case with a fake doctor exiting 65 advances the release; rerun scripts/product-release.sh on main advances to origin/main.
